categories.main_business_segments: GloryView Technology primarily operates in the fields of smart cities, intelligent computing (including high-performance computing and AI computing), and integrated solutions for digital transformation. Its business segments include smart city solutions (covering smart governance, smart municipal management, smart security, smart parks, and smart living), and computing power services such as GPU hardware procurement, cluster networking, and AI computing services. The company also provides operation and maintenance services and focuses on AIoT and AGI application scenarios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including artificial intelligence, big data, IoT, cloud computing, FPGA, GPU acceleration, and high-performance computing clusters. It employs system integration, software development, and hardware deployment methods to deliver comprehensive smart city and computing power solutions. The company emphasizes green, energy-efficient data center construction and intelligent operation, with proprietary R&D centers and patents in IoT sensing, AI security, digital twin, and intelligent control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: GloryView serves government agencies, public institutions, state-owned enterprises, and private enterprises primarily in sectors such as municipal governance, healthcare, education, tourism, agriculture, and industrial parks. Its major customers are located mainly in South China, especially Guangdong province, with expanding presence in the Yangtze River Delta and other regions. The company’s smart city and computing power services cater to clients requiring digital transformation and high-performance AI computing capabilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in China, with a strong presence in South China (Guangdong), and growing activities in Northeast, North China, East China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Sichuan to support business expansion. The company also plans to strengthen overseas market development as part of its medium- to long-term growth strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: GloryView operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the information technology and digital infrastructure supply chain. It integrates hardware procurement, system design, software development, and service delivery, acting as a system integrator and solution provider. The company does not manufacture core semiconductor components but assembles and deploys computing clusters and smart city infrastructure, providing value-added services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing smart city development, expanding intelligent computing power services, and pioneering AGI application scenarios. It invests heavily in R&D for AI, big data, IoT, and digital twin technologies, aiming to build integrated computing power service systems. The company emphasizes green and energy-efficient data center technologies, AI-driven intelligent operation, and continuous innovation to maintain competitive advantages and support digital economy growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (hardware and software solutions), system integration services, computing power equipment leasing, and operation and maintenance services. The company recognizes revenue upon contract fulfillment and customer acceptance for integration projects, and on a time basis for ongoing services. It also earns government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue comes from smart city projects and computing power service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GloryView positions itself as a leading national high-tech enterprise and a specialized 'little giant' in the smart city and intelligent computing sectors. It competes with other system integrators and computing service providers in China’s rapidly growing digital infrastructure market. The company leverages its comprehensive qualifications, extensive project experience, and strong customer base to maintain a competitive edge, especially in South China and emerging computing power markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 658 million, a 14.64% decrease from 2023, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 75.7 million. Despite the loss, the company’s total assets grew by 32.24% to RMB 2.87 billion, reflecting significant investment in computing infrastructure. The company’s R&D expenditure increased to RMB 54.8 million, representing 8.33% of revenue, indicating a focus on innovation. The business shows a transition phase with growth in computing power services offsetting declines in traditional smart city segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GloryView emphasizes its integrated smart city and intelligent computing solutions that combine cutting-edge AI, big data, IoT, and high-performance computing technologies. Its value proposition lies in delivering customized, full-process digital transformation services with strong technical innovation, energy-efficient infrastructure, and comprehensive project execution capabilities. The company’s extensive qualifications, patented technologies, and collaborative R&D ecosystem differentiate it as a trusted partner for government and enterprise clients seeking advanced digital infrastructure and AI-enabled services.
